Subject: Fwd: sample — can we run a quick pilot on Redwood?

Team — forwarding Alice's sample. Can you confirm:

1) Dataset format is fine (CSV with columns: id, context, question, canonical_answer, label, risk_score, rationale). We should provide a small conversion script for the customer if they want discrete fraud labels (suggest: low/medium/high using risk_score thresholds 0-40/41-70/71-100).
2) Proposed eval config: run three models (listed below) with the following probes:
   - Q&A: exact-match and normalized F1; threshold for pass = 88% exact-match OR normalized F1 >= 0.90
   - Intent classification: macro F1 target >= 0.82
   - Fraud triage: correlation (Spearman) between model risk score and Bancorp risk_score + human-review on top 50 discordant cases
3) Infra: Dev — can you confirm we can spin this up in the customer-dedicated tenant (sandbox) with 7b fp16 and 2.7b quant instances for parallel runs? Also include KV cache warmup to reduce cold-start variance.

Neha/Marcus — please advise if we should add additional regression checks (per-token divergence, distributional drift alerts) and what the gating logic should be to flag a quality regression. I want to include clear pass/fail criteria in our deliverable so the customer can decide on next steps.

Rough timeline: get greenlight from Dev today/tomorrow, run 5 business days, deliver report by next Friday 9/3. I will draft the run notes (redwood_eval_run_notes.md) and share the drive link.

Thanks,
Marissa
